description: WAF-Fronted ALB Has Directly Public Instance Target (Potential Bypass)
rationale: A registered EC2 target on an internet-facing ALB protected by AWS WAF or a known CDN/WAF has a public network interface and security group permitting its actual target port from the Internet. This is potential exposure, not proven reachability through routes, NACLs, host firewall or an application listener.
remediation: Restrict backend security groups to ALB security groups and remove unnecessary public addresses; verify network reachability independently.
